title: Prominence Ocean Breeze Prominence on 30a
meta_description: Prominence 30A beach house rental, Ocean Breeze located in Watersound, FL by Panhandle Getaways is 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all the conveniences of home. 4 Bikes Included
description_expanded: Description Description Prominence 30A beach house rental, Ocean Breeze located in Watersound, FL by Panhandle Getaways is 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all the conveniences of home. 4 Bikes Included LEARN MORE ABOUT THE PROMINENCE ON 30A NEIGHBORHOOD Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* 30A Beach House - 4 Bedrooms* Large Front Porch* Several Decks-Balconies to Enjoy* Walk or Bike Everywhere - 17 mile bike path* Large Living Area with 75" TV* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area* Bedroom 1 - Main Floor, King Bed, 2 Twin Sleeper Chairs, TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 2 - King Bed, TV, En Suite Bathroom, * Bedroom 3 - King Bed, TV* Bathroom 3 - Tub/Shower Combo* Bedroom 4 - Built In Bunk Bed (T/T), 2 Single Twin Beds, TV* Half Bathroom on Main Level* Full-Size Washer/Dryer* 2 Car Garage* Sleeps 12 30A Public Beach Access Points About Prominence on 30A - Watersound, FloridaProminence on 30A is certain to attract families looking to experience the area with easy access to new and long time 30A haunts along the beautiful white beaches of The Panhandle. Prominence features incredible amenities, open green spaces & easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Guests will enjoy the community's beautiful town center, 2 resort style pools, 1 heated seasonally and fitness center. The Big Chill, a family hot-spot for entertainment, features an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen which plays host to concerts, sporting events, movie nights on the green, family activities, restaurants and boutique shops. Guests will certainly enjoy Luke Bryan's place as it is a very popular place to gather. All of this within less than a 5 minute walk. Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of Seaside & Seagrove Beach on the west and Alys and Rosemary on the east. 20 minutes to Pier Park. COMMUNITY and THE BIG CHILL AMENITIESWalking distance to The Big Chill - Restaurants & Pubs, Boutique Shops & Nightly EntertainmentCigar and Gastro Pub - Luke Bryan's Place & Popular HangoutOnsite Ice MachineKids Movie Nights and Sports Viewings at the Hub2 Large Community Pool(s) with Beach Entry – perfect for the elderly and toddlersBarbecue AreasFitness FacilityProximity to the amenities at Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and Seaside5 miles to nearest Grocery Store ***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) Please note: Pool heated seasonally is subject to change at any time by the HOA for the community. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any change in seasonal heating of the one pool in Prominence. No refunds for any change to pool heated seasonally. Beach Accesses for ALL Prominence homes are via South Walton public beach access points. Most Prominence guests utilize Deer Lake State Park beach access or other nearby public beach accesses. Prominence homes do not have direct beach access via Watersound Club nor do they have access to Watersound private club facilities. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach.
